PCA Rotation Matrix (Loadings)

Source: R/pca_plots.R
rotation_matrix.Rd

PCA Rotation Matrix (Loadings)

Usage

rotation_matrix(PC_mod)

pca_loadings(PC_mod)

Arguments

PC_mod

A prcomp object.

Value

A tibble of feature loadings onto each principal component, with a feature_num column ("f1", "f2", ...) for compact labeling in pca_eqns.

Examples

pca_model <- prcomp(mtcars, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
rotation_matrix(pca_model)
